hypothesis: Direct gradient-based updates of two rank4 factorizations, without matrix reconstruction/SVD projection, can preserve a single 256-float state, reduce full 49-step CPU cost to <=3x the full W256 reference, and achieve final action consequence error no worse than 1.05x a stronger FIT-selected full 256-float conventional rule, across 2 independently seeded new source families.

source.generation: Reuse P92 pinned pure SHA256 integer/dyadic simulator with independent P93 source seeds; 49 new 16-dimensional continuous actions and 16-dimensional consequences from independent rank4 world-specific linear maps. In exactly half worlds switch map after confirmed action24; first48 action/effect pairs can be observed, 49th query has unknown future effect. No physical or independent external source.
source.audits: Strict SHA256 FIT and VAL cohort hashes must be pinned and match Windows/Linux; no exact repeated action keys (|cos|<.999), finite dyadic source, exactly 50% hidden-changed, no withheld answer in stream; source code denies reserved seeds.

models.full_fixed: CAL-locked P86 η=1, decay=.99, original full W16x16 256-float source-independent baseline, no training.
models.full_FIT_grid: FIT-only eta∈{0.5,1,1.5} × decay∈{.95,.99} 6 conventional W256 updates; select mean A+B FIT final-MSE only, before VAL.
models.dual_direct: Per-world one U[B,2,16,4]+V[B,2,4,16] pair of two rank4 slots -> exactly 256 predictive float32 values. Read p = sum_slot U_slot(V_slot @ normalize(action)). At observed action, r=observed_effect-p. Compute pre-update h_slot=V_slot@key and g_slot=U_slot.T@r. U_slot_new=sqrt(decay_slot)*U_slot+ etaU_slot * r outer h_slot/(||h_slot||²+.25). V_slot_new=sqrt(decay_slot)*V_slot+ etaV_slot * g_slot outer key/(||U_slot||_F²+.25), all gradients read from OLD state, update simultaneously. Initial U=zero, initial V=distinct deterministic signed Walsh-Hadamard 4x16 row groups (first slot rows0:4, second rows4:8) divided by4; deterministic and not source dependent. Fast slot decay∈{.95,.99}, slow decay fixed .999. ηU_fast∈{.10,.35,.75}, ηV_fast∈{.025,.10}; slow gains exactly quarter fast gains. No truncation, SVD, dense 16x16 candidate or future labels; state contains only U/V.
models.factor_grid: 12 FIT-only rules 3 etaU × 2 etaV × 2 fast decays. Select best mean A+B FIT MSE before any VAL. No VAL tuning.
models.ablations: Single fast rank4 (128 floats) and frozen V-coordinate 2-rank4 (etaV=0, 256 floats) evaluated with FIT-selected dual params as diagnostic, not VAL-tuned.
models.factual_rules: Read-before-write on 48 confirmed executed action/effect pairs; 49th query never writes. Bitwise exact state cold restore after event24; no extra per-world cursor, inferred regime flag, full-history cache or oracle.

qualify.source_admission: Exact source and P92 original blob custody, audited independent cohorts, strong fixed reference stable/changed each <=0.8*zero on both VAL families, wrong-credit rotated effect control >=1.5x clean and >=.01, bitwise 256-state restore, all finite. Fail closed.
qualify.quality: For EACH family: selected dual final MSE <=1.05x stronger of fixed full or FIT-selected full W256, dual stable and changed final each <=1.10x stronger full comparator, dual <=.95x both single-fast ablation and frozen-V ablation (diagnostic contribution of both state factors). All required; else DEV_FAIL_QUALITY. No OOD.
qualify.cost: Local single CPU thread; identical full 49-read/48-update VAL batch inputs, 5 warmups, 30 measured loops; median dual <=3x FIT-selected full W256 wall time in EACH family. Cost gate independent; no false 256-float end-to-end memory/compute equivalence; transient factor workspace and global code overhead reported. No GPU.
qualify.science: Even dev pass only synthetic dev hypothesis, not scientifically witnessed action-consequence transfer, independent retention, native full Hybrid training or scientific pass. Do not claim RSI/integration. No future source generated.
